notes.title: Space Revenge - Release!
notes.notes:
Space Revenge has just launched everywhere! 

It has a 15% discount for the launch week. Pick up a copy and start your quest for REVENGE!

[previewyoutube=IxHVsUfMK8g;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Special Stream Event
notes.notes:
On Wednesday, June 16th, at 10 AM Pacific, right at the start of the Steam Next Fest, our community team jumps in to play Nine to Five, discuss the Next Fest, and answer your questions!

Tune in if you want to beat us at our own game, have a laugh, or if you want to see what the game looks like before playing it yourself!

With thousands of titles around the globe, Steam presents the world's largest and most varied selection of games with an attractive live program. [i]The Steam Next Fest[/i]

And [b]Space Revenge[/b] is one of the selected games.

In order to celebrate it, we are going to stream 24/7 and let the users play our game in a public demo.

And this is not the only surprise we've got in store for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39019107/3e36d5b064bad3e8277dbcacfcfcbd7360b90924.png[/img]
